title: Canonical affine higher direct image computation: eventual vanishing
statement: Let S be a scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], I a nonempty directed preorder, and D : Iᵒᵖ → Over(S) an inverse system with affine transition morphisms and qcqs structure morphisms. Let c be a cone whose underlying scheme cone is limiting and whose structure morphism is qcqs. Let F_i be abelian etale sheaves [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], with unital compatible inverse-image maps φ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. Let H, eH and hH present the pulled-back coefficient diagram on the limit, with colimit F. For p ≥ 0, an affine etale object V of S [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], a stage i, and a section y of R^p g_i,* F_i [def-weil-pbc-direct-image] on V, suppose the canonical map [def-sbc-abelian-higher-direct-image-map] along c.π_i, with coefficient map eH_i.inv followed by the colimit coprojection, sends y to zero. Then there are j and f : i → j such that the canonical higher-image transition along D(f.op), with coefficient map φ(f), sends y to zero on the same V. No presentation K or colimit of the higher images is required.

proof.text: Use the natural sheafification comparison uniformly in stage and coefficients. The image sieve of the stage comparison covers V. On a local raw lift z, naturality and injectivity of the limit comparison identify the original zero hypothesis with zero of the sheafified raw limit class.

Apply local eventual vanishing of the raw class. Its witnesses, mapped through the same natural comparison, kill the original section locally. Cover transitivity shows the sieve of eventual-zero restrictions is covering.

Extract a finite subcover of affine V from the covering sieve using compactness and the open ranges of etale arrows. IsFiltered.wideSpan gives a common stage for the finitely many witnesses. Canonical transition composition keeps all restricted sections zero at that stage; naturality and sheaf separatedness give zero on V. The empty subcover case is included by the same wideSpan and separatedness argument.

proof_origin.place: Tag 09Z1 proof, natural comparison of Tag 03Q8, local raw-class vanishing and finite-cover assembly; Lean proof written by H3

mathlib_searches.query: A higher direct image section on an affine etale object killed by the inverse limit comparison becomes zero at a later stage
Cohomology classes of abelian etale sheaves on an inverse system with affine transitions that vanish at the limit vanish at a later stage
mathlib_searches.results: Eight results about structure sheaf sections under affine limits, abstract sheaf cohomology, and homotopy classes; none states the canonical higher-direct-image section assertion.
Sheafification unit, naturality, lifting and isomorphism lemmas; no scheme-system higher-image continuity comparison.

The existing HigherDirectImageAffineSectionVanishing theorem assumes a presentation K with a colimit and imports the assigned local theorem, so it cannot be imported without a cycle. Fixed-coefficient module-sheaf affine continuity does not cover varying abelian coefficients. No canonical affine statement in Mathlib.

theorem exists_higherDirectImage_affine_computation_eq_zero {S : Scheme.{v}}
    {I : Type v} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)] [Nonempty I]
    (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Over S)
    [∀ {i j : Iᵒᵖ} (f : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map f).left]
    [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, QuasiCompact (D.obj i).hom]
    [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, QuasiSeparated (D.obj i).hom]
    (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit ((Over.forget S).mapCone c))
    [QuasiCompact c.pt.hom] [QuasiSeparated c.pt.hom]
    (F : ∀ i : I, Sheaf (D.obj (op i)).left.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1})
    (φ : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j),
      (((D.map f.op).left)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}]).obj (F i) ⟶ F j)
    (hφid : ∀ i : I, HEq (φ (𝟙 i))
      ((upperStarId AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (D.obj (op i)).left).hom.app (F i)))
    (hφcomp : ∀ {i j k : I} (f : i ⟶ j) (g : j ⟶ k), HEq (φ (f ≫ g))
      ((upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (D.map g.op).left
          (D.map f.op).left).hom.app (F i) ≫
        (((D.map g.op).left)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}]).map (φ f) ≫ φ g))
    (H : I ⥤ Sheaf c.pt.left.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1})
    (eH : ∀ i : I, H.obj i ≅
      (((c.π.app (op i)).left)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}]).obj (F i))
    (hH : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j), H.map f =
      (eH i).hom ≫
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (c.π.app (op j)).left (D.map f.op).left
          (c.π.app (op i)).left
          (congrArg (fun t => t.left) (c.w f.op)).symm).hom.app (F i) ≫
        (((c.π.app (op j)).left)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}]).map (φ f) ≫ (eH j).inv)
    [HasColimit H] (p : ℕ)
    (V : S.Etale) [IsAffine V.left] (i : I)
    (y : ((DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor _ (p : ℤ)).obj
      (R+(((D.obj (op i)).hom)_*[AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}]).obj
        ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj (F i)))).obj.obj (op V))
    (hy : (abelianHigherDirectImageMap (c.π.app (op i)).left
      (D.obj (op i)).hom c.pt.hom (Over.w (c.π.app (op i))) p
      (F i) (colimit H) ((eH i).inv ≫ colimit.ι H i)).hom.app (op V) y = 0) :
    ∃ (j : I) (f : i ⟶ j),
      (abelianHigherDirectImageMap (D.map f.op).left (D.obj (op i)).hom
        (D.obj (op j)).hom (Over.w (D.map f.op)) p (F i) (F j) (φ f)).hom.app
          (op V) y = 0
